formal_statement: (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 15 ∧ ∃ o0 o1 o2 : ℕ, ∀ x : Fin 6 → Bool, (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD o0 false = ((x 0 && x 3) || (x 1 && x 4) || (x 2 && x 5)) ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD o1 false = ((x 0 && x 4) || (x 1 && x 5) || (x 2 && x 3)) ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD o2 false = ((x 0 && x 5) || (x 1 && x 3) || (x 2 && x 4))) ∧ ¬ (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 14 ∧ ∃ o0 o1 o2 : ℕ, ∀ x : Fin 6 → Bool, (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD o0 false = ((x 0 && x 3) || (x 1 && x 4) || (x 2 && x 5)) ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD o1 false = ((x 0 && x 4) || (x 1 && x 5) || (x 2 && x 3)) ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD o2 false = ((x 0 && x 5) || (x 1 && x 3) || (x 2 && x 4)))
plain_statement: On six inputs a0, a1, a2 (inputs 0 to 2) and b0, b1, b2 (inputs 3 to 5), let F_s be the OR over i of a_i AND b_(i + s mod 3), for s = 0, 1, 2. The three functions are wires of one circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with 15 gates, and of no such circuit with 14 gates.
title: Three cyclic matchings of K(3,3): joint circuit size exactly fifteen, the sum of the single sizes
